Hello, fellow Taoists!

The immortal cultivation theme flight shooting RPG "Demonslayer AKA Me" produced by us has been officially released today! You can enjoy a 12% off discount for the first week if you buy it now.

The game has a classic horizontal version of the flight shooting gameplay. Fellow Taoists can freely explore, practice, and fight in the vast immortal cultivation world, and find the immortal fate of ascension and breakthrough in the highly free adventure process.

If you encounter any problems during the game, you can submit them to us.

notes.title: Role description
notes.content:
Male lead: player, 18 years old, 185 tall, 140 weight.

Actress: Liu Yi, 15 years old, 158 in height and 92 in weight. The only daughter of Shan Yunfan, the disciple of Floating Flower Valley and the elder of Floating Flower Valley, is good at wooden magic.

Actress: Han Tingfang, 29 years old, 163 in height and 100 in weight. The disciple of Hongguang Valley is good at refining pills.

Actress: Yue Hongyan, 60 years old, 168 in height and 105 in weight. The disciple of the Wanshang League is extremely beautiful. The head of the Wanshang League Sifang Store is good at using ice magic.

Male supporting role: Wei Pengyun, 20 years old, 190 in height and 180 in weight. The disciple of Wanyuan Sect is good at earth magic.

Male supporting role: Qi Yong'an, 40 years old, 172 in height and 130 in weight. The disciple of the Butian Sect is good at refining equipment and magic weapons.

Male supporting role: Gu Heyu, about 1000 years old, 168 in height and 115 in weight. Suspected to be a disciple of the Burning Moon Temple.

Supporting role: Long Shiqing, 38 years old, 160 in height and 100 in weight. The disciple of Qihai Sect is good at water magic.

notes.title: World background
notes.content:
Within nine days, the world is numerous, and there is an unnamed boundary with a very wide range. Unfortunately, it has not been favored by the heaven, and the spirit is thin, and the people who can achieve it are slim. One day, there was a surge of dragon poison above the nameless boundary, and the five colors were crisscrossed, which lasted for three years. After that, the snow of crystal jade fell one after another, and the gathered ones included ten thousand feet of strange mountains, a thousand feet of still lake, a stretch of sand sea and an endless ice field. Among them, the spirit was permeated, and the most precious treasure appeared at every moment. The people who practiced it were thousands of miles in a day, and many people who built the spiritual foundation, formed the golden pill, and condensed the baby, and even had the talent of heaven's indulgence, and turned the spirit into the Tao, which was almost immortal. Because it is said that the snow of crystal jade is the crystal dust of the ninth heaven, all living beings in this world are named after the boundary of crystal dust.

There are three continents in the world of crystal dust, called fairy dust, ice field and wilderness. The fairy dust and the ice land are both inhabited by the human race, and the wild land inhabited by the demon race is a corner of each other. Because the human race is powerful, the demon race dare not act recklessly. One day, an island appeared in the sea in the northern part of the barbaric mainland, and the evil spirit was filled. Later, there was a source of Demon troops, killing people regardless of people and demons, with the intention of occupying the world of immortality, so the two groups of people and demons joined hands in real time to fight against the Demons.

There is a mountain called Jiutian Mountain on the Xianchen Continent, and there is a peak in the mountain called Hongyun Peak. There is a view of burning the moon on the peak. It is said that all the people in the view are powerful people who can control objects and fly, control various kinds of sky fires, and gather to burn the moon, so it is called the view of burning the moon (fire).

There is a large market town in the southwest of the Burning Moon Temple. There are four main roads leading to the Piaohua Valley (wood), Wanyuan Gate (earth), Hongguang Valley (alchemy) and the Burning Moon Temple, which is named Sifang Ji. There are people of all kinds of practices who stay in the center all the year round, and trade with fairies. There are many commercial pavilions. Among them, the largest one is the Sifang Branch of the Wanshang League, which contains magic spells, array flags, magic elixirs, and so on.

There is a village thirty miles southeast of Sifangji, called Qingshui Village, which is named after Qingshui River near the village. This is the story of cultivating immortals

notes.title: School Profile (2)
notes.content:
Feimiao Peak: Soul root attribute: no feature: array, seal character. Auxiliary sects mainly control, stimulate, defend and weaken, and cooperate with teammates by various means.

In the 36th year of Jingchen, Fu Shiyun entered the period of integration. After more than 300 years of hard work, he still could not get close to the realm of refining emptiness. So the cloud traveled to the fairy dust, the ice field and the wild land, hoping for opportunities. A hundred years passed in a flash, and finally we got good news that there was an island overseas where exiled immortals lived in seclusion. After another hundred years, he finally arrived at Yinxian Island. The immortals showed compassion for his sincerity and gave him the book "Sifang Shu" according to what he learned. For 2600 years, Jingchen finally got into Mahayana with the help of the array contained in "Sifang Shu". Although its spiritual power is weaker than other Mahayanas, it is not weaker than people according to the script and array. Then he set up a misty peak. Although they are not allowed to enter the gate of heaven, all the previous leaders of the war of human and devil have been close to the Shuai and the disciples, and have assisted the human army with various mysterious arrays, which have won the praise of the world.



Butian Sect: Spirit Root attribute: no feature: auxiliary sect, the most powerful weapon and equipment.

In the four years of Jingchen, Qu Yuanzheng proved that he was weak. He was overjoyed and roared. A person with evil thoughts, who is weak in spirit after cheating him to break the mirror, wants to kill and seize the treasure, but is killed. Qu Yuanzheng found a book on the man named "Record of Remedying the Sky". All the records in the book are about the cultivation of magic weapons. Qu Yuanzheng was originally good at the cultivation of weapons. He was very happy to get this book. Since then, the deeper the way of refining the weapon, the more powerful the weapon can be compared with Lingbao. In 2836 years of Jingchen, Qu Yuan was under the protection of the original magic weapon "Wuding Mirror", which he was refining, and obtained the Mahayana, so he established the Heavenly Sect to spread the way of refining weapons. Although the way of refining weapons has reached the highest level, it is difficult to make progress in its own cultivation, so it is not allowed to enter the gate of heaven. Although Qu Yuanzheng has entered reincarnation, the Heavenly Mending Sect created by him stands proudly in the world of immortality and is one of the nine major sects.



Beast Sect: Soul Root Attribute: No feature: auxiliary sect, cooperating with combat. It can greatly stimulate the power of spirit pet.

The Beast Gate is a remote sect in the northeast corner of Xianchen mainland. It is said that the founder of the sect is a late Taoist. Although his kung fu is mediocre, he has a thousand-ren centipede that is not far away from him. He has defeated the Lianxu Taoist many times. All disciples of the sect take cultivating spiritual pets as the first priority, and their self-cultivation takes the second place. Although the people of this sect are not in a high level, the spiritual pet they feed is extremely powerful. People who practice Taoism dare not despise it. At present, the patriarch, Duke Zhongliang, although the realm is stagnant in the refining, but the mountain-piercing animals he nurtured, even the people of Mahayana, have no way to win. In all previous wars between humans and demons, the Terran army often takes all kinds of spiritual pets driven by the disciples of the Beast Clan as the vanguard. The people of the Demon Clan are also hard to resist, but the cultivation of spiritual pets is not easy, and should not be lightly used.



Wanshanmeng: Linggen attribute: no characteristic: a business giant, the best source of obtaining immortal goods, and the best family of welfare.

After ten years of crystal dust, due to the snow falling on crystal jade, the spirit grass and spirit minerals in all continents are extremely rich. There is an expert in the practice of virtuality named Hua Zimo. He knows that his skill is not good. Although the mainland is full of spirit, he may no longer have the power to break the mirror. So he opened a shop in Fengqi City, specializing in the needs of people who practice Taoism. Because of its proper operation, it has made huge profits. There are admirers who want to hold their wings. Hua Zimo also knows the crime of Huaibi. In order to seek peace, she joined hands with many merchants to establish the Wanshang Alliance, which is the cornerstone of the Wanshang Alliance. It is extremely difficult for people who practice Taoism to have children, but Huazimo and his descendants have passed on from generation to generation. At that time, the leader of the alliance, Hua Le'an, was a Taoist prodigy who entered Mahayana in only four thousand years. As a result, the reputation of Wanshanmeng is growing, and it is also one of the nine major sectors.



Jingshan Sect: Spiritual root attribute: no feature: the school that values self-cultivation is the easiest to learn.

Jingshan Zong is the most mysterious sect in the Jingchen world. Nobody knows its origin. It is said that the disciples of his sect are all energetic, but not good at fighting with others. In several wars between humans and demons, only a few disciples joined the Terran army. Because his disciples also have no evil deeds, the people who practice Taoism also pay no attention to him.



Tianlong Sect: Spiritual Root Attribute: No feature: The sect that has a lot of experience in planting spiritual plants often has a good harvest.

In the 1848 year of Jingchen, the Taoist priest Qiu Hongyi found the ancient secret script "Spiritual Grass Collection" in Zhongqu Mountain, so he built a cave in Zhongqu Mountain, opened up the Spiritual Fields and planted them according to law. Qiu Hongyi has been worried about the spirit grass since then. He has exchanged the spirit grass for countless pills, and has achieved great success for thousands of years. In the 3600 years of Jingchen, a Tianlong was born in Tianmen Peak. Qiu Hongyi took this auspicious omen and founded the Tianlong Sect in Xianchendu. After opening the guild, the secret of cultivating the spirit grass attracted a large number of practitioners to join. Because it did not attach importance to the spirit root of its disciples, the number of disciples would be thousands if the guild was established for less than ten years. Although there are not many people in the middle and high levels of the sect, those who practice Taoism often have a great demand for spirit grass. Therefore, in the world of crystal dust, everyone is modest to the Tianlong Sect. After the reincarnation of Taoist Hongyi, all the previous leaders of the sect were kind to others, so the sect became more and more prosperous. If counted by the number of disciples, it was only weaker than the peerless Sword Sect.

notes.title: School Profile (I)
notes.content:
The peerless Sword Clan: Soul Root Attribute: Gold Feature: The attack type sect uses the sharpest sword to penetrate everything and make a quick decision.

In 1860 years, Jingchen finally entered Mahayana by breaking the mirror with his sword. So he searched all over the land of immortality, and finally found a place where the golden gas gushed out at the southern end of the land, and established a sect to preach. Because all his life's lessons are about swordsmanship, with his body attached to his sword and nothing can match it, he is named the peerless Sword Sect. After the opening of the sect, it has accepted the talents of the Jin-generation spirit root. Only 800 years ago, the number of disciples in the sect has exceeded 1000, making it the largest group in the world of crystal dust. Another five thousand years later, on one day, a seven-colored giant sword appeared over the gate of the peerless Sword Clan. It became more and more bright after several calamities of wind, fire, thunder and poison. People within a thousand miles felt the supreme pressure and could not help falling down. After worshipping, the giant sword disappeared. Since then, although there has been no trace of faithfulness in the world of crystal dust, the peerless sword sect has a long history of talents, and its fame has not fallen for tens of thousands of years.



Floating Flower Valley: Soul Root Attribute: Wood Feature: auxiliary sect, which can defeat the opponent by controlling, dispersing, poisoning and recovering, with long stamina.

In the first year of Jingchen, the snow of Jingyu fell in succession. There was a mountain depression more than 2000 miles southwest of Fengqi City, and the snow of Jingyu was piled up like a mountain. There is a peach tree at the bottom of the col, which is moistened by spirituality. Only a few years later, spirituality has begun to show. After that, the Jingyu Snow Mountain turned into vitality and poured into the peach tree. The peach tree was strong, with ten thousand flowers and falling petals. It came in a continuous stream for more than ten miles. Therefore, the world called it Floating Flower Valley. There are three friends who practice virtuality. Hearing this vision, they come together and delimit the valley as a courtyard. No one is allowed to enter. Two thousand years later, the three people practiced Buddhism under the peach tree and created various second decisions. Among them, the famous Hongyu finally broke the mirror. The three people said: OK! Therefore, the Piaohua Valley Sect was established, and the disciples of the wood-generated spiritual roots were widely collected, and many methods such as breaking the demons, returning to the Yuan Dynasty, and clearing the Ming Dynasty were spread. Because the peach tree bears thousands of peaches every ten years, which is of great help to those who practice, the disciples of the sect practice faster than other sects and are widely respected by those who practice. Unfortunately, after the establishment of the sect, the three people took kindness as their heart, and frequently went out of the valley to kill the demons and demons, eliminate the plague and eliminate the epidemic, so as to save the common people. Later, they did not advance in practice and were unable to cross the plunder. Although they had a good end, they could not enter the gate of heaven.



Qihai Sect: Spirit root attribute: water feature: all-powerful sect, which can defeat the opponent by attacking, defending, controlling and recovering, and can attack and defend.

In the third year of Jingchen's life, there was a cardamom girl Lu Shuiyun who built a foundation mirror. Her family were all killed by her enemies. She escaped to the frozen land alone. In the rare Tianxiang Mountain, we found a cave where the magic power of the protective array was exhausted. There were several copies of immortal mental skill and hundreds of different kinds of immortal pills. The spirit gathering array in the cave absorbed the snow of crystal jade within a thousand miles and turned it into vitality. In this way, only seven hundred years later, Lu Shuiyun can break the combination and achieve virtuality. Later, he returned to the land of immortality and killed all his enemies. The world thought that the magic methods he used were bestowed by heaven, so he was respected as the Shuiyun Fairy. In memory of the unknown Taoist who left the cave, he returned to the ice land, and set up the Qihai Sect in the name of the cave. However, Tianark Mountain is a bitter and cold place, so the disciples are not prosperous and the sect is not obvious. In the 6312 years of Jingchen, the sky above Qihaizong was thundered, and a crystal water drop rose slowly. After the seven-color sky thunder lasted for more than a month, the water drop leaped thousands of miles and went straight to Tianmen Peak in Xianchen, which shocked the world. As a result, the name of Qihai Sect rose rapidly and finally became one of the nine major sects.



Burning Moon Temple: Soul root attribute: Fire feature: attack type sect, mainly attack and stimulate, supplemented by control. The fiercest flame melts everything.

In the first year of the crystal dust, the snow of crystal jade in the crystal dust world was flying, which lasted for three years, during which all kinds of mysterious lights flashed, and there were rumors of the birth of a precious treasure. For four years, Taoist Hongsheng felt that although the spirit of the world was magnificent, he was over 500 years old, and there was no time to go. The state was still stagnant in the late stage of the pill formation, and there was no hope of breaking the mirror. So he traveled to the land of immortality to find a spiritual reincarnation. You can swim to Hongyun Peak in Jiutian Mountain and marvel at its magnificent valley. The scenery is beautiful and the heart is very happy. You can choose the place where the spirit is to build a minimalist cave and wait for reincarnation. One morning, I felt a palpitation in my heart. I saw a flash of red not far away. It seemed to have the meaning of calling, so I searched for it in the air. At that time, the red color dissipated, and there were six leaves of jade book and a piece of fiery red pill. Taoist Hongsheng pondered for a long time, took the pill and took it, then tilted it slightly. The flame was entangled, the colors were rotating, the clothes were burned, and it didn't fall to the ground. One day later, he wakes up from the feeling that he is light and healthy, just like a teenager. The earth spirit in his body is gone and the fire spirit is full, but the state falls to practice Qi. Taoist Hongsheng rebuilt the foundation with the mental skills contained in the six-leaf jade book, and achieved the Mahayana realm for only more than 1800 years. Because of its prominent reputation and numerous apprentices, it was named the Burning Moon Temple. Because its fire system skill is good at conquering the Demons, the Burning Moon Temple has been hidden as the head of the human race for several times. It is said that Taoist Hongsheng has been able to cross the plunder and fly up, but his heart to protect the human race is even more serious. Therefore, he has struggled to suppress the aura in his body for tens of thousands of years as the last barrier of the human race.



Wanyuan Sect: Soul Root Attribute: Earth Feature: Defensive sect, which focuses on defense and recovery.

In the second year of Jingchen, Taoist Wenhe went to Jiutian Mountain to search for treasure. Three years later, he really waited for the birth of the treasure and got a armor made of Shengguang Jade. The armor was engraved with various secrets, all of which were used to defend, strengthen and protect the enemy. Taoist Wenhe entered Mahayana in 2130 years of Jingchen. He opened the sect called Wanyuan Gate, and took the talent of earth and spirit as his disciple. His mental skill is to attack the weak and defend the strong. He has taken the responsibility of defense in several wars between people and demons. It is said that he once competed with Taoist Hongsheng about Yingyue. Taoist Hongsheng was deeply impressed that he could not win. In the 69113 year of Jingchen, Taoist Wen He went to the Tianmen Peak to cross the robbery. He sat on the top of the peak and only opened a spirit mask. Water, fire, electricity, poison, heart and other natural skills could not get close to him. After three months of robbery, he got up and smiled and walked slowly into the Tianmen.



Hongguang Valley: Soul Root Attribute: Five Element Feature: Auxiliary Sect, and those who get the elixir will succeed.

In the 811 year of Jingchen, Liu Linglong succeeded in building the foundation of Qihai Sect. In the next 30 years, there was no further progress. With the permission of the teacher Shuiyun Fairy, he left the sect and looked for another opportunity. In 850 years, he met a real immortal in the mountains of Zhongqu Mountain, and gave him a wonderful book, "The Source of Dan", instructing him to cultivate grass with spirit, raise pills with grass, and cultivate spirit with Dan. Linglong then found a place of spirit in Jiutian Mountain, opened a cave, nurtured spirit grass, built an elixir furnace, and became an elixir. Only more than 2100 years later, he broke the mirror and became the first Danxiu in the world of crystal dust. Later, the sect was named Hongguang Valley, and its disciples were widely accepted. Because of its many secrets that were not handed down, and the various sects had many requirements, people in the Jingchen world were proud to make friends with their disciples. Ten thousand years later, Linglong disappeared from the world, and the disciples in the valley did not know where it was, and the people who practiced in the Jingchen world gradually forgot about it.
